import sys

n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())

# Read the strings
strings = [sys.stdin.readline().strip() for _ in range(n)]

# Read the number of questions
Q = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())

# Process each question
for _ in range(Q):
    L, R, str = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    L, R = int(L), int(R)
    
    # Count the number of strings in the range [L, R] that contain the substring str
    count = 0
    for i in range(L - 1, R):  # Adjust for 0-based index
        if str in strings[i]:
            count += 1

    print(count)
